credentials.title: Dropbox authentication
credentials.description: Recommended: create refresh-token credentials with `python -m source_dropbox.oauth authorize --app-key <APP_KEY>`, then paste the generated JSON fields here.

app_key.title: Dropbox App Key
app_key.description: The App key shown in your Dropbox App Console. This identifies the app; it is not a client secret.

refresh_token.title: Dropbox Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Long-lived token generated with the PKCE helper. It is used to obtain short-lived Dropbox access tokens automatically.

access_token.title: Dropbox Access Token
access_token.description: A manually generated Dropbox access token. Use refresh-token authentication for production connections.

path.title: Root Path
path.description: Dropbox folder path to synchronize. Use an empty string to synchronize from the app root.

recursive.title: Include subfolders
recursive.description: When enabled, synchronize the configured folder and all of its descendants.

include_deleted.title: Include Deleted Entries
include_deleted.description: Include deletions in the incremental entries change stream. Snapshot streams always omit deleted Dropbox metadata.

file_contents.title: File Content Extraction
file_contents.description: Optional settings for the file_contents stream. Extraction is disabled until the stream is selected and allowed_extensions is configured. Requires the files.content.read Dropbox scope.

allowed_extensions.title: Allowed Extensions
allowed_extensions.description: Explicit lowercase extension allow-list, for example .pdf or .docx. An empty list disables extraction.

max_file_size_mb.title: Maximum File Size (MB)
max_file_size_mb.description: Do not extract files larger than this size.

timeout_seconds.title: Extraction Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for Dropbox Riviera conversion of one file.
